user.title: Bambu AMS Monitoring – Setup
user.description: Enter the base URL of your Bambu AMS Monitoring backend and an API key. Create the key on the settings page of the backend, under "Network access".

select_printers.title: Select Printers
select_printers.description: Select the printers whose monitoring state you want to control. A printer can be selected here even if another integration instance already uses it.

reauth_confirm.title: Bambu AMS Monitoring: New API Key
reauth_confirm.description: The backend at {base_url} no longer accepts the API key of this integration. Create a new key under "Network access" on its settings page and enter it here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the backend. Please check the URL.
error.invalid_auth: The backend did not accept this API key. Create one under "Network access" on its settings page.

abort.reauth_successful: The new API key is accepted.

edit_printers.title: Edit Printers
edit_printers.description: Select the printers this integration should monitor. Leave the API key empty to keep the one this entry already holds, and fill it in only to replace that key.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the backend. The printers currently configured are still selectable.
error.invalid_auth: The backend did not accept this API key, so nothing was saved. Create one under "Network access" on its settings page.
